# 1. Load Package

```{python}
import io
import shutil
import sqlite3
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from datetime import datetime

import pandas as pd
import requests

from py.config import cfg
from py.utils_dates import make_quarter_tbl
from py.utils_db import sqlite_path
```

# 2. Setup

```{python}
dates = make_quarter_tbl(
    start_year=cfg.start_year,
    end_year=cfg.end_year,
)

workers = 3  # throttling for SEC request limit
```

# 3. Functions

## 3.1 SEC master file

```{python}
def qtr_master_file(date: pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
    qtr = int(date.quarter)
    yr = int(date.year)

    master_link = (
        f"https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/full-index/{yr}/QTR{qtr}/master.idx"
    )

    print(f"Downloading master file for quarter {qtr} of year {yr}...")

    tmp_path = cfg.data_dir / "tmp.txt"

    ok = False
    for attempt in range(1, 4):
        print(f" Master attempt {attempt}...")
        try:
            response = requests.get(
                master_link,
                headers={"User-Agent": cfg.sec_user_agent},
                timeout=cfg.timeout_sec,
            )
            response.raise_for_status()
            tmp_path.write_bytes(response.content)
            ok = True
            break
        except requests.RequestException:
            print("  Master download failed, waiting 30s before retry")
            time.sleep(30)

    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to download master.idx for {yr} Q{qtr}")

    lines = tmp_path.read_text(encoding="latin-1", errors="ignore").splitlines()
    content = "\n".join(lines[11:])

    master = pd.read_csv(
        io.StringIO(content),
        sep="|",
        header=None,
        names=["cik", "name", "type", "date", "link"],
        dtype=str,
    )

    master = master.loc[
        master["type"].str.match(r"^13F-HR(/A)?$", na=False)
    ].copy()
    master["link"] = "https://www.sec.gov/Archives/" + master["link"]
    master["file"] = master["link"].str.rsplit("/", n=1).str[-1]

    if tmp_path.exists():
        tmp_path.unlink()

    return master.reset_index(drop=True)
```

## 3.2 Download files into staging dir

```{python}
def dwnld_files(master: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    cfg.staging_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    master = master.drop_duplicates(subset=["file"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    n_files = len(master)

    def download_one(item: tuple[int, pd.Series]) -> None:
        idx, row = item
        file_path = cfg.staging_dir / row["file"]
        success = False

        for attempt in range(1, 4):
            try:
                response = requests.get(
                    row["link"],
                    headers={"User-Agent": cfg.sec_user_agent},
                    timeout=cfg.timeout_sec,
                )
                response.raise_for_status()
                file_path.write_bytes(response.content)
                success = True
                break
            except requests.RequestException:
                wait = 5 * attempt
                print(
                    f"\nFile {idx + 1}/{n_files} attempt {attempt} failed, waiting {wait}s"
                )
                time.sleep(wait)

        time.sleep(0.3)

        if not success:
            print(f"\n*** Gave up on filing {idx + 1}/{n_files}: {row['file']} ***")

    print("Starting parallel file downloads...")
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as executor:
        list(executor.map(download_one, master.iterrows()))

    print("\nQuarter filings downloaded (a few may still be skipped)")
```

## 3.3 Put all forms in SQLite database

```{python}
def put_files_in_sql(dbname) -> None:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(dbname)

    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS compsubm")
        cur.execute("CREATE TABLE compsubm (FILENAME TEXT, COMLSUBFILE TEXT)")

        files = sorted([p for p in cfg.staging_dir.iterdir() if p.is_file()])
        step = 500

        for start in range(0, len(files), step):
            batch_files = files[start : start + step]
            rows = []

            for f in batch_files:
                content = f.read_text(encoding="latin-1", errors="ignore")
                rows.append((f.name, content))

            cur.executemany(
                "INSERT INTO compsubm (FILENAME, COMLSUBFILE) VALUES (?, ?)",
                rows,
            )
            conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()

    shutil.rmtree(cfg.staging_dir, ignore_errors=True)
```

# 4. Run functions

```{python}
for i, row in dates.iterrows():
    yq = row["year_qtr"]
    print(f"\n=== Quarter {i + 1}/{len(dates)}: {yq} ===")

    start_time = datetime.now()
    print(start_time)

    master = qtr_master_file(row["date"])

    master.to_csv(
        cfg.master_index_dir / f"master_{yq}.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    print(f"Downloading {len(master)} files...")
    dwnld_files(master)

    print("Loading to SQL...")
    put_files_in_sql(sqlite_path(yq))

    end_time = datetime.now()
    elapsed = end_time - start_time

    print(
        f"Total time for {yq}: {elapsed.total_seconds() / 60:.1f} minutes "
        f"({elapsed.total_seconds():.1f} seconds)"
    )
```
